title: Green Lane Park Deep Creek Campground

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: All Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission laws apply on the two lakes and the Perkiomen Creek. All boats using any waterways in GLP must be electric or non-powered. A private boat rental concession rents boats at the Hill Road Day Use Area. Canoes, kayaks, standup paddleboards, paddleboats, and small fishing boats with electric motors are normally available to rent from May through September (weather permitting). Boating on Deep Creek Lake closes from the first lake freeze, until the Fish & Boat Mentored Youth Trout Day. If you are looking to kayak for the day, Deep Creek Lake is for you!
